storey-rule.sql:
WITH project_entities AS (
    SELECT et.EntityIndex AS ProjectEntity, e.Document AS DocumentIndex
    FROM EntityText et
    JOIN Entities e ON e.rowid = et.EntityIndex
    WHERE et.Category = 'IFCPROJECT'
),
project_length_unit AS (
    SELECT ep.Entity AS EntityIndex, sv.Strings AS LengthUnit
    FROM Parameters ep
    JOIN Descriptors ed ON ed.rowid = ep.Descriptor
    JOIN Strings edn ON edn.rowid = ed.Name
    JOIN Strings sv ON sv.rowid = ep.Value
    WHERE edn.Strings = 'Ifc:LengthUnit'
),
project_length_scale AS (
    SELECT ep.Entity AS EntityIndex, env.Numbers AS LengthUnitToMetre
    FROM Parameters ep
    JOIN Descriptors ed ON ed.rowid = ep.Descriptor
    JOIN Strings edn ON edn.rowid = ed.Name
    JOIN Numbers env ON env.rowid = ep.Value
    WHERE edn.Strings = 'Ifc:LengthUnitToMetre'
),
document_units AS (
    SELECT pe.DocumentIndex,
           plu.LengthUnit,
           CAST(pls.LengthUnitToMetre AS DOUBLE) AS LengthUnitToMetre
    FROM project_entities pe
    LEFT JOIN project_length_unit plu ON plu.EntityIndex = pe.ProjectEntity
    LEFT JOIN project_length_scale pls ON pls.EntityIndex = pe.ProjectEntity
),
storey_elevations AS (
    SELECT ep.Entity AS EntityIndex, CAST(env.Numbers AS DOUBLE) AS ElevationSource
    FROM Parameters ep
    JOIN Descriptors ed ON ed.rowid = ep.Descriptor
    JOIN Strings edn ON edn.rowid = ed.Name
    JOIN Numbers env ON env.rowid = ep.Value
    WHERE edn.Strings = 'Ifc:Elevation'
),
storeys AS (
    SELECT
        et.EntityIndex AS source_entity_index,
        et.StepId AS source_local_id,
        COALESCE(et.GlobalId, '') AS source_global_id,
        et.Name AS source_name,
        ds.Strings AS source_document,
        se.ElevationSource AS elevation_source,
        du.LengthUnit AS length_unit,
        du.LengthUnitToMetre AS length_unit_to_metre
    FROM EntityText et
    JOIN Entities e ON e.rowid = et.EntityIndex
    JOIN Documents d ON d.rowid = e.Document
    JOIN Strings ds ON ds.rowid = d.Title
    LEFT JOIN storey_elevations se ON se.EntityIndex = et.EntityIndex
    LEFT JOIN document_units du ON du.DocumentIndex = e.Document
    WHERE et.Category = 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY'
),
known AS (
    SELECT *, elevation_source * length_unit_to_metre AS elevation_m
    FROM storeys
    WHERE length_unit_to_metre IS NOT NULL AND elevation_source IS NOT NULL
),
unknown AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM storeys
    WHERE length_unit_to_metre IS NULL OR elevation_source IS NULL
),
lagged AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(elevation_m) OVER w AS prev_elevation_m
    FROM known
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY elevation_m, source_document, source_local_id)
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(CASE WHEN prev_elevation_m IS NULL OR elevation_m - prev_elevation_m > 0.01524 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            OVER w2 AS group_id
    FROM lagged
    WINDOW w2 AS (ORDER BY elevation_m, source_document, source_local_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT group_id,
        median(elevation_m) AS group_elevation_m,
        count(DISTINCT source_document) AS cluster_documents
    FROM grouped
    GROUP BY group_id
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT group_id, source_name, count(*) AS n
    FROM grouped
    GROUP BY group_id, source_name
),
canonical_names AS (
    SELECT group_id, source_name AS canonical_name
    FROM (
        SELECT group_id, source_name, n,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC, source_name ASC) AS rn
        FROM name_counts
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
same_doc_counts AS (
    SELECT group_id, source_document, count(*) AS doc_rows
    FROM grouped
    GROUP BY group_id, source_document
),
clustered AS (
    SELECT
        g.source_entity_index, g.source_local_id, g.source_global_id, g.source_name, g.source_document,
        g.elevation_source, g.length_unit, g.length_unit_to_metre, g.elevation_m,
        gs.group_elevation_m, gs.cluster_documents, cn.canonical_name,
        'storey/' || CAST(CAST(ROUND(gs.group_elevation_m * 1000) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || 'mm' AS canonical_key,
        (g.elevation_m - gs.group_elevation_m) * 1000 AS elevation_delta_mm,
        (lower(trim(g.source_name)) = lower(trim(cn.canonical_name))) AS name_agrees,
        (sdc.doc_rows > 1) AS same_document_in_cluster
    FROM grouped g
    JOIN group_stats gs ON gs.group_id = g.group_id
    JOIN canonical_names cn ON cn.group_id = g.group_id
    JOIN same_doc_counts sdc ON sdc.group_id = g.group_id AND sdc.source_document = g.source_document
),
unmatched AS (
    SELECT
        source_entity_index, source_local_id, source_global_id, source_name, source_document,
        elevation_source, length_unit, length_unit_to_metre,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS elevation_m,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS group_elevation_m,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS cluster_documents,
        source_name AS canonical_name,
        'storey/unknown/' || source_document || '/' || CAST(source_local_id AS VARCHAR) AS canonical_key,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS elevation_delta_mm,
        CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS name_agrees,
        FALSE AS same_document_in_cluster
    FROM unknown
),
all_storeys AS (
    SELECT source_entity_index, source_local_id, source_global_id, source_name, source_document,
           elevation_source, length_unit, length_unit_to_metre, elevation_m, group_elevation_m,
           cluster_documents, canonical_name, canonical_key, elevation_delta_mm, name_agrees,
           same_document_in_cluster
    FROM clustered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source_entity_index, source_local_id, source_global_id, source_name, source_document,
           elevation_source, length_unit, length_unit_to_metre, elevation_m, group_elevation_m,
           cluster_documents, canonical_name, canonical_key, elevation_delta_mm, name_agrees,
           same_document_in_cluster
    FROM unmatched
),
name_clusters AS (
    SELECT lower(trim(source_name)) AS name_key, canonical_key
    FROM all_storeys
    WHERE source_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(source_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY lower(trim(source_name)), canonical_key
),
name_in_other AS (
    SELECT a.source_entity_index, TRUE AS name_in_other_cluster
    FROM all_storeys a
    JOIN name_clusters nc1 ON nc1.name_key = lower(trim(a.source_name)) AND nc1.canonical_key = a.canonical_key
    JOIN name_clusters nc2 ON nc2.name_key = nc1.name_key AND nc2.canonical_key <> nc1.canonical_key
    GROUP BY a.source_entity_index
),
global_id_other AS (
    SELECT a.source_entity_index, TRUE AS global_id_shared
    FROM all_storeys a
    JOIN all_storeys b ON b.source_global_id = a.source_global_id
        AND b.source_global_id <> ''
        AND b.canonical_key <> a.canonical_key
    GROUP BY a.source_entity_index
)
SELECT
    'storey' AS concept,
    'storey-by-elevation' AS rule,
    1 AS rule_version,
    'tolerance=0.05 ft (0.01524 m)' || CHR(59) || ' offset-threshold=0.5 mm' AS rule_parameters,
    a.source_document,
    a.source_entity_index,
    a.source_local_id,
    a.source_global_id,
    a.source_name,
    a.canonical_key,
    a.canonical_name,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS target_entity_index,
    CASE WHEN a.cluster_documents >= 2 THEN 'Candidate' ELSE 'Unmatched' END AS rule_status,
    CASE WHEN a.cluster_documents >= 2 THEN 'Candidate' ELSE 'Unmatched' END AS status,
    concat_ws(',',
        CASE WHEN a.name_agrees = FALSE AND a.cluster_documents >= 2 THEN 'name-differs' END,
        CASE WHEN ABS(a.elevation_delta_mm) >= 0.5 THEN 'elevation-offset' END,
        CASE WHEN nio.name_in_other_cluster THEN 'name-in-other-cluster' END,
        CASE WHEN a.same_document_in_cluster THEN 'same-document-in-cluster' END,
        CASE WHEN a.length_unit_to_metre IS NULL THEN 'length-unit-unknown' END
    ) AS conflicts,
    concat_ws(',',
        CASE WHEN gio.global_id_shared THEN 'global-id-in-other-cluster' END
    ) AS warnings,
    a.elevation_source,
    a.length_unit,
    a.elevation_m,
    a.elevation_delta_mm,
    a.name_agrees,
    COALESCE(gio.global_id_shared, FALSE) AS global_id_shared,
    a.cluster_documents,
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS axis_copies,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS claimed_room_number,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS room_name_agrees,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS decided_by,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS decided_at,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS decision_note
FROM all_storeys a
LEFT JOIN name_in_other nio ON nio.source_entity_index = a.source_entity_index
LEFT JOIN global_id_other gio ON gio.source_entity_index = a.source_entity_index
ORDER BY a.canonical_key, a.source_document, a.source_local_id

correspondence.sql:
WITH rule_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM t1
),
confirmations_typed AS (
    SELECT
        concept,
        source_document,
        TRY_CAST(source_local_id AS BIGINT) AS source_local_id,
        canonical_key,
        decision,
        decided_by,
        decided_at,
        note
    FROM t4
),
ranked_confirmations AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY concept, source_document, source_local_id, canonical_key
            ORDER BY decided_at DESC, CASE WHEN decision = 'Rejected' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        ) AS rn
    FROM confirmations_typed
),
latest_confirmations AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked_confirmations WHERE rn = 1
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        r.concept, r.rule, r.rule_version, r.rule_parameters,
        r.source_document, r.source_entity_index, r.source_local_id, r.source_global_id, r.source_name,
        r.canonical_key, r.canonical_name, r.target_entity_index,
        r.rule_status,
        COALESCE(c.decision, r.rule_status) AS status,
        r.conflicts, r.warnings,
        r.elevation_source, r.length_unit, r.elevation_m, r.elevation_delta_mm,
        r.name_agrees, r.global_id_shared, r.cluster_documents, r.axis_copies,
        r.claimed_room_number, r.room_name_agrees,
        c.decided_by, c.decided_at, c.note AS decision_note
    FROM rule_rows r
    LEFT JOIN latest_confirmations c
        ON c.concept = r.concept AND c.source_document = r.source_document
       AND c.source_local_id = r.source_local_id AND c.canonical_key = r.canonical_key
),
no_rule_rows AS (
    SELECT
        c.concept, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS rule, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS rule_version,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS rule_parameters,
        c.source_document, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS source_entity_index, c.source_local_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS source_global_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS source_name,
        c.canonical_key, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS canonical_name, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS target_entity_index,
        'NoRuleRow' AS rule_status,
        c.decision AS status,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS conflicts, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS warnings,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS elevation_source, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS length_unit,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS elevation_m, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS elevation_delta_mm,
        CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS name_agrees, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS global_id_shared,
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS cluster_documents, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS axis_copies,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS claimed_room_number, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS room_name_agrees,
        c.decided_by, c.decided_at, c.note AS decision_note
    FROM latest_confirmations c
    LEFT JOIN rule_rows r
        ON r.concept = c.concept AND r.source_document = c.source_document
       AND r.source_local_id = c.source_local_id AND r.canonical_key = c.canonical_key
    WHERE r.source_entity_index IS NULL
)
SELECT * FROM matched
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM no_rule_rows
ORDER BY concept, canonical_key, source_document, source_local_id

session.description: Snowdon federation correspondence table (TKT-30). Only the storey-by-elevation rule (C5) is wired so far. C6 adds grid-rule and space-rule as two more duck.query nodes over `union`, wired into `correspondence` as t2 and t3 alongside this chunk's t1 (storey-rule) and t4 (confirmations); their SQL follows the grid-axis-by-tag and space-in-room-by-room-number semantics in docs/plans/snowdon-federation-build.md. Deviation from the plan's Correspondence table contract: `conflicts` and `warnings` are comma-joined VARCHAR, not VARCHAR[], because every sink and every multi-input node (sink.exportParquet's DuckWriting.CopyTable, sql.query's per-input WriteTable) round-trips its input table through Ara3D.BimOpenSchema.IO.DuckDbUtils.WriteTable, whose Append() has no branch for array-typed values and silently stringifies them (`v.ToString()`) instead of writing a LIST column. An empty string means no conflicts/warnings.
